claude.sample_unit: Spanish-language patient educational materials on childhood glaucoma

links.outcome: Reading level of original Spanish patient education materials on childhood glaucoma (INFLESZ)
links.effect: Original PEMs had mean INFLESZ score of 56.6 ± 4.9 (8th-grade level), above the recommended 6th-grade level; ChatGPT-4o revision raised it to 69.6 ± 2.3 (4th- to 6th-grade, P < .001).
links.quote: Original PEMs had a mean INFLESZ score of 56.6 ± 4.9 (8th-grade level).

links.outcome: Readability and quality of LLM-simplified patient education materials in plain language
links.effect: ChatGPT-4o improved readability from 56.6 ± 4.9 to 69.6 ± 2.3 (P < .001); quality stayed high (median 15 in both groups, P = .74); no hallucinations observed.
links.quote: ChatGPT-4o significantly improved readability to 69.6 ± 2.3 (4th- to 6th-grade level, P < .001).

links.effect: Mean INFLESZ improved from 56.6 ± 4.9 to 69.6 ± 2.3; P < .001.
links.quote: ChatGPT-4o significantly improved readability to 69.6 ± 2.3 (4th- to 6th-grade level, P < .001).

links.effect: Quality median score = 15, P = .74; no hallucinations observed.
links.quote: Quality remained high across both groups (median score = 15, P = .74), and no hallucinations were observed in artificial intelligence-generated text.

links.outcome: Readability of AI-revised Spanish patient educational materials
links.effect: ChatGPT-4o significantly improved readability from 56.6 ± 4.9 to 69.6 ± 2.3 (4th- to 6th-grade level, P < .001)
links.quote: ChatGPT-4o significantly improved readability to 69.6 ± 2.3 (4th- to 6th-grade level, P < .001).
